verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo and wordmark large and dominant, but the pink circle is stretched into an ellipse and cropped at the right, top and bottom edges. The 'Fig' descender also collides with the ellipse edge, and the tagline is pushed far from the wordmark inside the blob, which breaks the logo-tagline grouping. B shrinks the logo and wordmark until they are tiny and jams them against the left edge. Its distorted ellipse becomes the main visual weight, holding only the small tagline, and the right third of the canvas is dead space, so the hierarchy is inverted and the brand is trivialised.
